exposure: maternal age of 35 years old or above
history of curettage in prior pregnancy
hemoglobin level equal to or less than 10 g/dL
fundal height of 38 centimeters or above
use of pethidine for pain relief in the 1st stage of labor
outcome: postpartum blood loss over 300 mL after vaginal delivery
postpartum blood loss over 500 mL after vaginal delivery
cohort: The study included 504 pregnant women (72 cases, 432 controls) with a gestational age of 28 weeks or above who underwent vaginal delivery at Chiang Rai Regional Hospital.
finding: The developed risk scoring system showed acceptable performance in predicting postpartum blood loss over 300 mL (sensitivity 80.7%, specificity 60.8%) and 500 mL (sensitivity 88.1%, specificity 54.6%) after vaginal delivery.
